offering_description.value: Dutch Bros sells made-to-order coffee, energy drinks and other beverages to consumers through company-operated and franchised drive-through shops. It also supplies coffee and other products to franchisees.

primary_products.value: coffee and espresso drinks; energy drinks; teas; lemonades; smoothies

customer_segment.value: B2C: Consumers buying made-to-order drinks; B2B: Franchise operators buying coffee and shop supplies

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prepared drinks sold at company-operated shops and supplies sold to franchisees; licensing or royalties: Franchise fees and royalties for operating branded shops

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Prepares drinks from coffee and other ingredients and sells them to consumers; OEM / manufacturer: Roasts coffee beans for company-operated and franchised shops; other: Licenses its shop brand and operating system to franchisees

geography_served.value: US regional: Multiple U.S. regions, with a concentration in the West and Sun Belt

specialization.value: related lines: Coffee, energy drinks, teas, lemonades and smoothies sold through the same shops

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated drive-through shops; partners / resellers: Franchised drive-through shops; online: Mobile order-ahead for pickup at participating shops

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Beverage preparation and retail operations subject to state and local food safety rules and health inspections

notes: The exact current state footprint is uncertain.
